# technitium_sso (Resource)

Manages the Technitium DNS Server Single Sign-On (OpenID Connect) configuration. Singleton resource — one per provider instance. In a cluster the SSO configuration syncs from the Primary node to all Secondary nodes automatically.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable Single Sign-On (SSO) with OpenID Connect (OIDC).

### Optional

- `allow_signup` (Boolean) Automatically provision user accounts for new users signing in via SSO.
- `allow_signup_only_for_mapped_users` (Boolean) Only allow new SSO users to sign up when they are a member of at least one remote group mapped in group_map.
- `authority` (String) The OpenID Connect (OIDC) Authority URL, e.g. https://keycloak.example.com/realms/master.
- `client_id` (String) The OpenID Connect (OIDC) Client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The OpenID Connect (OIDC) Client Secret. The server never returns the real secret, so drift in this attribute cannot be detected — the configured value is authoritative.
- `group_map` (Map of String) Map of remote (OIDC provider) group names to local group names. SSO users' local group membership is synced from this map on every login.
- `metadata_address` (String) Custom OIDC metadata discovery URL. Only needed when the SSO provider uses a non-default discovery URL.
- `scopes` (List of String) OIDC scopes to request. Defaults to the server default (openid, profile, email) when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier: sso.
